title: Skincare for Hostel Students: A 3-Product Routine on a Budget
ex: A simple face wash, moisturiser and sunscreen routine for hostel and PG life, with fixes for hard water, shared bathrooms, exams and pimples.
rt: Skincare for Hostel Students: 3-Product Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skincare for hostel students: a 3-product routine (face wash, moisturiser, sunscreen), fixes for hard water and pimples, and how to make a small jar last.
quick: Hostel students need only a gentle face wash, a moisturiser and a sunscreen, used every morning and night. Rinse with lukewarm water, moisturise damp skin within a few minutes, change your pillow cover weekly and avoid starting several active products at once.
facts: Three products are enough for most students
A 15 g jar lasts about 3–4 weeks at a pea-sized amount
Add one active product at a time
